thoughts: The current layout, while clean, lacks the technical weight required for a medical-grade ergonomic brand. To improve dwell time and conversion, I am shifting the copy to be strictly data-driven and technical, focusing on the mechanical properties of the 'bioactive lattice'. The visual asset prompt is refined to emphasize the material science aspect, and the layout is adjusted for maximum clarity of technical specifications.

subhead.text: Engineered with a variable-density elastomer matrix that provides 360-degree pressure neutralization. Validated to reduce spinal torque and peak cutaneous pressure by up to 37% for optimized musculoskeletal recovery.

visual_asset.prompt_signature: Ultra-macro 8k footage of a surgical-grade white polymer lattice under mechanical stress test. The structure compresses under high-precision calipers and exhibits 100% elastic memory upon release. Lighting is sterile laboratory white with sharp shadows that define the geometric precision of the internal hexagonal cells.

attributes.camera_movement: Slow vertical dolly zoom on the lattice compression point.
attributes.color_grade: High-contrast clinical monochrome with subtle olive-drab depth.
attributes.lighting: Hard directional laboratory lighting to emphasize structural rigidity.
attributes.subject_focus: The geometric deformation and recovery of the bioactive material.
